description:
smart-me is a metering platform for buildings. This app connects ChatGPT to a smart-me account, so you can ask about your meters in ordinary language instead of opening the portal.

You can ask what a meter reads right now, how much a heat pump or an apartment used over a period, what that costs at the current tariff, when the daily peak was, and how consumption developed over days or months. It reads quarter-hourly load profiles and daily series, the folder structure of a site, EV charging stations with their sessions and settings, load management groups, and the tariffs and consumption behind a building's energy bill.

With your confirmation it can also make changes: rename meters, create and organise folders, switch a relay, send a command to a charging station, set charging current limits, and set up the tariffs and units used to bill self-consumption in a shared building. Every change is shown to you before it happens. Deleting a folder or a charging station takes two steps, and the second one requires the exact name.

You need a smart-me account and sign in with it. Long series of measured values need a smart-me Professional licence; single readings work on any account. The app acts only inside your own account, with your own permissions, and stores nothing.

defaultPrompt: Which meters are in my account, and what do they read right now?
Show me the last 7 days of the solar meter as a chart.
Is anything charging right now, and how much is the whole group drawing?
